title: Add capability index projection
verified: Capability catalog renders as a read-only TUI projection.
Catalog includes service recovery, package install, untrusted content, rootfs update, support bundle, AOM activation preview and local AOM artifacts.
Every capability has an authority path, required approvals and a launch path constrained to intent or preview.
Unavailable or degraded capabilities include reason and source.
Catalog declares planner_logic=false and resolver_logic=false; resolver ownership remains agent_core::ecosystem.
capabilities.show and capability.list are typed TUI commands and do not export support bundles or activate AOM artifacts.
risk_notes: Capability Index is projection-only and does not own runtime, planner, resolver or side-effect authority.
AOM activation remains preview-only in the catalog and active set mutation remains outside TUI.
Support bundle capability exposes palette preview rather than direct export.
Normal shell remains denied and no host shell/file manager launch path was added.
